title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1011 | 长角洛基海参、十月流星雨、爱泡澡的变形虫
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🌊 阿根廷海底大峡谷发现 57 个全新物种，其中一只长角海参被取名"洛基"！
🌠 十月是流星雨季，地球正穿过哈雷彗星留下的尘埃带！
♨️ 加州火山公园发现"火焰变形虫"，爱泡 145 度高温热水澡！

📖 Word of the day: meteor（流星）

🎮 小挑战：晴朗的夜晚和爸爸妈妈去户外看流星，抬头看天五分钟数数看到几颗，看到就许个愿！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🌊 Scientists found 57 brand-new deep-sea animals off Argentina — including a horned sea cucumber named Loki!
🌠 October is meteor shower season — Earth is flying through space dust left by Halley's Comet!
♨️ A "fire amoeba" was discovered in California's volcanic pools — it loves 145-degree hot water!

📖 Word of the day: meteor

🎮 Tiny challenge: on a clear night, look up at the sky for five minutes with your parents and count the shooting stars — make a wish if you see one!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. meteor（流星）
a bright line of light in the sky when a tiny space rock burns up
例：a bright meteor（明亮的流星）

2. canyon（峡谷）
a deep, narrow valley — here, a giant one under the sea
例：an underwater canyon（海底峡谷）

3. horn（角）
a hard, pointy part growing on an animal's head
例：Loki's little horns（洛基的小角）

4. burn up（燃烧殆尽）
to burn completely until nothing is left
例：The space dust burns up.（太空尘埃燃烧殆尽。）
